# Engineering Tutorial: Designing a Reliable Request-Processing Service

## 1. Introduction

In modern distributed systems, the boundary between a "script that works" and a "production service" is defined by reliability. A reliable service is not merely one that processes data correctly when everything is going well; it is one that maintains integrity, availability, and observability when things go wrong.

The core mandate of the service we are designing is fourfold:
1. **Record requests:** Durable ingestion of incoming work.
